faqs.question: Which is better for ceilings, gypsum or POP?
faqs.answer: Gypsum is faster to install, cleaner and gives a uniform finish. POP is better for intricate curves and custom mouldings. Many designs combine both: gypsum for flat areas and POP for decorative details.

faqs.question: How much does a false ceiling cost per sq ft?
faqs.answer: It depends on the material and design. As a rough guide, PVC and grid ceilings are the most economical, gypsum and POP are in the middle, and wooden or metal ceilings cost more. Use our cost calculator for an estimate. We give an exact quote after a free site visit.

faqs.question: How long does installation take?
faqs.answer: A standard 12×10 ft false ceiling usually takes 2–4 days including lighting and painting. A wall panelling or louver feature wall usually takes 1–3 days. You get a timeline with your quote.

faqs.question: How much ceiling height will I lose?
faqs.answer: Typically 4–6 inches for a single-level ceiling, and a little more where there are cove or multi-level sections. We advise based on your room height during the site visit.

faqs.question: Can a false ceiling be installed in a bathroom or kitchen?
faqs.answer: Yes. We recommend PVC or moisture-resistant gypsum boards for wet and humid areas.

faqs.question: Which is better, PVC or WPC wall panels?
faqs.answer: PVC is fully waterproof and budget-friendly, so it's ideal for bathrooms, kitchens and damp walls. WPC is thicker, looks more like real wood and suits feature walls such as TV and bed back walls. Many homes use both.

faqs.question: Can wall panels be installed on damp walls?
faqs.answer: Wallpaper and MDF panels should not go on damp walls. PVC panels can, but it's always better to fix the cause of dampness first. We check walls for moisture during the site visit and recommend the right option.

faqs.question: How long does a gypsum partition take to build?
faqs.answer: Most office cabins and room partitions are completed in 2–5 days, including jointing and painting, which is much faster than a brick wall.

faqs.question: Do you handle the electrical and lighting work?
faqs.answer: Yes. Lights, cove LED strips and wiring are planned and installed along with the ceiling, so you deal with one team.

faqs.question: Is the site visit really free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Measurement and consultation are free, with no obligation to book.
